stemMd: Which structure is normally present in both a leaf mesophyll cell and an animal liver cell?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Large central vacuole with a tonoplast

explanationMd: Both plant and animal cells require mitochondrial respiration. Photosynthetic plant cells can contain chloroplasts as well, but chloroplasts do not replace their mitochondria.

distractorRationale.a: Animal cells lack a cellulose wall.
distractorRationale.d: Plasmodesmata connect plant cells through their walls.
distractorRationale.c: This is characteristic of many mature plant cells.
distractorRationale.b: Liver cells do not contain chloroplasts.
